limitations: The upper bound is computer-assisted after an exact reduction and does not automatically generalize to higher dimensions. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the full theorem text of Sun and Wang (2025) was not inspected, although the later August 2026 general-position survey states that exact hypercube values were known only through dimension seven.
provenance: An exact extremal theorem for binary length-eight (2,1)-separating systems, equivalently binary 2-frameproof codes and general-position sets in the 8-dimensional hypercube, proved by a distance reduction and symmetry-complete exact verification.
record_title: Exact size of binary (2,1)-separating systems of length eight
